Twemoji v14.0.2
https://github.com/twitter/twemoji

Copyright 2020 Twitter, Inc and other contributors.
Graphics licensed under CC-BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

This directory contains a curated subset (~80 icons — hearts, stars,
emotions, effects, arrows) of Twemoji's SVG graphics, fetched from the
official GitHub repository (github.com/twitter/twemoji, tag v14.0.2) and
vendored unmodified for local, no-build-step use in the Canvas editor's
sticker picker. Filenames are the emoji's Unicode codepoint(s) in hex,
Twemoji's own naming convention.

Attribution per CC-BY 4.0: graphics by Twitter, Inc and other contributors,
licensed under CC-BY 4.0.
